left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with (suspicion of) primary  [OR] or recurrent EOC  [AND] with an indication for surgery, [OR]  chemotherapy  [OR] and/or immunotherapy

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Other active malignancy in past 5 years prior to entry into the study, except for treated non-melanoma skin cancer

left.raw_text: -  Any known severe infection like HIV, [OR]  hepatitis A, [OR]  B  [OR] and C

right.raw_text: -  Medical  [OR] or psychological condition which in the opinion of the investigator would not permit the patient to complete the study or sign meaningful informed consent
